retainedEvidence.limitations: Historical evidence; no current authentication, role, or response-shape claim.

freshObjective: Current-session authentication and current-date shape/error drift cannot be established from retained October evidence. Run one bounded passive capture and, only after terminal review/disposition and owner shutdown, one separately owned repeat when feasible. Each has independent artifacts; unchanged output is allowed.

authority.userGoal: Finish PR230 and exercise representative read-only fresh collection; normal sign-in for the previously selected account explicitly allowed.

authenticationRecovery: Use cached account first; normal OS/browser sign-in only for the previously selected account. Stop on new consent, account ambiguity, role/feature absence, or unavailable login. No device-code flow.
failureRecovery: Preserve all artifacts/checkpoints. No unchanged retry after an unavailable route or failed authentication. Incomplete bodies require a distinct observed retention/state remedy and a new reviewed plan. Never infer removal.
